title: worldmapframe
summary: MSUI's fullscreen M-map now carries the current Benilla surface: WorldMapUiLaw owns the preserved 1024x768 scale-to-fit and letterbox-centered host transform, blackout and twelve-piece shell/detail grid, map viewport, exact GameFontNormal title and clamped-32px WorldMapTextFont hover label, action/close seats, current/arbitrary zone and continent selection, exact continent/zone dropdown capsule slices and fixed-width lists, continent click-to-drill and right-click/Zoom Out navigation, map-fraction marker/highlight projection, explored-overlay chunk rectangles, additive zone highlight, facing-rotated MinimapArrow player marker, corpse marker, and its left/right screen-half tooltip seat. The corpse label now publishes through the shared typed classic GameTooltip renderer with its explicit law-owned anchor/pivot and authored red text instead of an ImGui tooltip window. The former extra center view label is removed because the two authored dropdown selections already carry that state. GameLoop.WorldMap contains no local Vector2 geometry. Focused WorldMap and GameTooltip interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: No click-to-navigate (ProcessMapClick): a continent view's zones cannot be clicked into, and arbitrary zones cannot be viewed - only own-zone <-> own-continent toggling
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: The continent view resolves the hovered zone through WorldMapZoneHitCatalog's .zmp grid; left click selects its exact WorldMapArea, while right click and Zoom Out return to the selected continent without snapping back to the player's map.

2026-08-22: WorldMapUiLaw freezes the two UIDropDownMenuTemplate capsules at the reference anchors, 130px declared width, 16px rows, 15px borders, and 32-row cap. The renderer uses CharacterCreate-LabelFrame slices, scroll-down button art, Dialog backdrop, check marks, stable continent file order, case-insensitive zone-name order, exact selections, and law-owned hit geometry rather than ImGui placement.

openItems.text: No exploration/discovery overlays (explored sub-areas painting their detail over the base parchment)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: DrawWorldMapExploredOverlays walks WorldMapOverlay rows for the selected map area, gates each by PLAYER_EXPLORED_ZONES through AreaTable exploration flags, expands authored texture chunks, and clips them to the detail map.

openItems.text: No hovered-area highlight (ADD-blend zone highlight) and no hovered-area label pair
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: The continent hover resolves its zone through the authored hit grid, draws the zone's additive Highlight texture with POT crop extents, and emits the WorldMapText-style centered area label above the detail map.

openItems.text: Player blip is a plain circle with no facing (Benilla spins MinimapArrow art by GetPlayerFacing)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: World-map player projection now calls the shared DrawMinimapPlayerArrow with the live player orientation, rotating the authored Interface/Minimap/MinimapArrow art instead of drawing an orientationless circle.

openItems.text: Re-review the WorldMapFrame XML and host source against the current Benilla snapshot after its source rewrite and world-module split.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: The XML rewrite preserves the same fullscreen geometry, map-space projection, overlay tiling, hover, dropdown, click, marker, and zoom behavior. The Rust delta is Benilla-internal module movement, developer gating, and per-VM catalog/exploration memoization; it introduces no MSUI desktop rendering or interaction delta.

openItems.text: Live verify the complete world-map interaction at multiple UI scales: both dropdown capsules/lists, arbitrary continent and zone selection, click-to-drill/right-click zoom-out, explored overlays, hover art/label, player facing arrow, corpse marker, click-away ownership, and return to Current Zone.

WorldMap used hand-sized raw text for its title and hovered-area label, seated both incorrectly, and drew an extra center view label absent from the current XML despite the authored dropdowns already exposing the selection.
openItems.resolution: WorldMapUiLaw now owns the exact GameFontNormal title center and WorldMapTextFont hover-label center after the runtime SetFont(33) byte-law clamp to 32px. GameLoop.WorldMap consumes those font objects and removes the non-authored duplicate view label; focused and full desktop clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: The corpse marker tooltip followed ImGui's implicit cursor position instead of current Benilla's screen-half side pick: ANCHOR_LEFT on the right half and ANCHOR_RIGHT on the left half.
openItems.resolution: WorldMapUiLaw owns the marker-vs-map-center side pick and corresponding tooltip anchor/pivot; the shared GameTooltip renderer now applies it with the authored red Corpse label.

openItems.text: The corpse tooltip had acquired the correct screen-half seat but still painted its content through a generic ImGui tooltip callback instead of Benilla's shared classic GameTooltip presentation.
openItems.resolution: The shared GameTooltip coordinator now exposes an owner-anchored typed adapter that accepts WorldMapUiLaw's resolved anchor and pivot, publishes the authored red Corpse line, prepares the existing classic WowSkin tooltip shell, and retains immediate-hide ownership. Existing shared-tooltip callers keep their prior default pivot. Focused WorldMap and GameTooltip checks pass.

openItems.text: WorldMap's dropdown toggle stayed in its pushed texture for the entire open state, selected rows omitted UIDropDownMenu's locked highlight, and row picks played the capsule-toggle cue instead of UChatScrollButton.
openItems.resolution: WorldMapUiLaw now derives both 130px capsules from DropdownCapsuleUiLaw. The renderer uses held-only pushed art, the shared selected check plus locked additive row highlight, and the exact distinct toggle/row sounds while preserving fullscreen scaling, list geometry, selection, navigation, and click-away behavior. Focused WorldMap checks pass.
